en-US.author: BRIGHT ZENITH PRIVATE LIMITED
en-US.description: Meet New Qoder, An Agentic Coding Platform for Everyone. You bring the idea, and Qoder gets it done.
en-US.longDescription:
The all-new Qoder. Powered by agentic coding. You bring the idea, and Qoder gets it done. New Qoder originated from Quest mode in Qoder IDE and is now an independent desktop product. The two products are available side by side and do not replace each other. Choose Qoder IDE if you prefer writing and debugging code directly in an IDE. Choose Qoder if you prefer delegating an end-to-end task to an Agent. Conversation history and memory are stored separately in each product. When getting started, use Data import to bring supported task records, memories, and extension settings from Qoder IDE, Codex, and other apps into your work.

How Qoder works
A typical workflow is:
1. Choose a mode. Coding groups tasks by workspace and provides execution-mode and branch controls; General groups tasks by folder.
2. Describe the goal, expected result, and constraints, then attach files or other context when needed.
3. Select a model and access mode, then send the task. Qoder reads the relevant context, plans the work, and calls tools.
4. Follow commands, file changes, and intermediate results; add requirements or redirect the task when necessary.
5. Inspect the result and run an appropriate validation. For tasks that change code, review the diff before deciding whether to keep, commit, or continue iterating.

Main areas
| Area                                   | Purpose                                                                                  |
| -------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Coding and General                     | Switch between workspace-based engineering tasks and folder-based general tasks          |
| New Task and Search                    | Start an independent task or search conversation titles and message content              |
| Workspaces or Folders and Recent tasks | Organize tasks by project and return to existing context                                 |
| Needs Me                               | Review requests awaiting a response, task results, and collaboration messages.           |
| Knowledge Base                         | Open More → Knowledge base to organize requirements, designs, and other task references. |
| Repo Wiki                              | Open More → Repo Wiki to generate and read knowledge about a code repository.            |
| Automations                            | Start Agent work on a schedule and review every run                                      |
| Extensions                             | Manage Skills, Plugins, and Connectors                                                   |

View activity and benefit reminders
When an activity notification or benefit reminder appears in the sidebar, open it for details and follow the instructions to participate or claim the benefit. Reminders depend on the notifications available to your account. Check eligibility and complete the required steps before participating or claiming a benefit; receiving a reminder does not complete those actions.

Capability map
Start a new task: Choose Coding or General, associate a workspace or folder, and enter the task.
Model selection: Select a built-in model or configure a supported custom model.
Task management: Search, sort, filter, archive, and restore tasks.
Tools and actions: Use the built-in browser, code review and commit flow, and terminal.
Security and access: Understand account, credential, and access authorization boundaries. See Code Security for scanning.
Environment and execution: Choose an execution environment and use plan- or goal-driven workflows.
Connect devices: Connect Qoder devices on your local network and work in authorized workspaces.
Automation: Schedule repeatable tasks and inspect every run.
Knowledge Base: Manage reference material and use it in tasks.
Repo Wiki: Generate and maintain project knowledge for code repositories.
Extensions: Extend Qoder with Skills, Plugins, Connectors, Hooks, agents, AppShot, and Computer control.
Agents: Configure local or cloud Agents with reusable instructions and resources.
Personalize Qoder: Configure modes, voice, shortcuts, models, memory, and other application preferences.
Image and video generation: Describe a scene and style, generate an image or video, and review the result. BYOK is not currently supported.
Office Plugins: Work with spreadsheets and presentations using Excel and PPT plugins, then review, edit, and save results on desktop.
en-US.name: Qoder
en-US.releaseNotes:
Take Documents and Sites Further

Features
- Word plugin: Adds a Word plugin for opening, editing, and saving DOCX files in Qoder, with conversation-based assistance for working on document content.
- Sites design canvas: Adjust Site page content and layout on a design canvas and use annotations to request changes. Add website templates as task attachments and choose a design style while keeping your own instructions.
- Local browser access for remote tasks: Supported remote sessions can use an authorized connection to operate the controlling device’s Qoder built-in browser alongside remote execution.
- HarmonyOS tap-to-share: On supported HarmonyOS devices, transfer images and PDFs from a phone into the current local task or a new task draft, or send local files to the phone with tap-to-share.
- Enterprise approval controls: Enterprise policies can restrict Full Access and Auto approval. When a mode is disabled, subsequent operations follow an available approval mode.

Improvements
- Agent Teams: Select members from the current device, the cloud, and other devices on the same account, enabling collaboration when required. Connected-device workspaces can use their associated teams. Leaders on other devices can participate in discussions; local tasks remain subject to the execution restrictions of the leader’s device.
- Plugin creation: Adds the built-in Plugin Creator to improve conversational plugin creation, customization, and packaging, combining Skills, commands, Agents, Hooks, MCP, and related capabilities.
- Local extension installation: Install plugins and Skills by dragging or pasting files. Plugins requesting Qoder SDK access show a manual authorization prompt during installation or permission changes.
- Plan and Goal: After reviewing a plan, choose Goal execution in supported tasks to continue working toward an explicit outcome.
- SSH and WSL: Improves connection management and workspace creation, including direct SSH host entry, authentication selection, and connection reassociation. Manually disconnecting pauses automatic reconnection while preserving workspaces and task records.
- Device connections: Sets initial pairing permissions according to the account relationship and improves address validation and local-network diagnostics. Explicitly confirm before stopping remote work for an update, and reference cached conversations from offline devices in local tasks.
- Model selection: New tasks can default to an available free official model when the account is confirmed to have exhausted its credits. Adds large-context usage hints, exclusive-pack balance notices, and clearer rate-limit messages.
- Diagnostics and feedback: Improves Qoder Helper’s Hook timing diagnostics and troubleshooting for remote devices.
- Cross-device automations: Use the slash menu in a connected-device conversation to create automations that run and are managed on that device. This entry is not available in SSH or WSL conversations.

Fixes
- Fixed stalled backward navigation, missing chapter entries, and conflicts between search navigation and returning to the bottom in long conversations.
- Fixed derived tasks losing custom groups, some forked tasks remaining unusable after initialization failures, and missing history links for background subagents.
- Fixed restoring one task in an archived workspace also restoring other archived tasks.
- Fixed failures when sending structured or Sites template attachments to remote tasks, or withdrawing and resending queued attachments. Also fixed remote Office attachment previews, saving, and generated-file access.
- Fixed inconsistent model catalogs, default models, and enterprise model categories in cross-device conversations.
- Fixed remote recent-conversation ordering, synchronization recovery after catalog subscriptions end, and live voice state display.
- Fixed initial handoff to remote teams, references in follow-up delegation, collaboration activation for plugin Agents, and team history display after account switches.

zh-CN.description: 用于现实软件的自主智能编程平台
zh-CN.longDescription:
Qoder 全新形态。以编程智能体为核心引擎，从想法到实现，轻松搞定。 New Qoder 源自 Qoder IDE 的 Quest 模式，现在已发展为独立的桌面端产品。两款产品并行提供、互不替代：如果你习惯直接在 IDE 中编写和调试代码，可以继续使用 Qoder IDE；如果你更倾向于把完整任务委派给 Agent，可以使用 Qoder。 两款产品的历史会话和记忆彼此独立。首次使用时，可以通过数据导入迁移 Qoder IDE、Codex 等应用中受支持的任务记录、记忆和扩展配置，继续已有工作。

Qoder 如何工作
一次完整的工作通常包含以下环节：
1. 选择模式。编程按工作区组织任务并提供执行模式和分支选项；通用按文件夹组织任务。
2. 用自然语言说明目标、交付结果与限制，并按需添加文件或其他上下文。
3. 选择模型和授权方式后发送任务。Qoder 会读取相关内容、规划步骤并调用工具。
4. 在执行过程中查看命令、文件改动和阶段结果；需要时补充要求或调整方向。
5. 查看结果并完成与任务相符的验证。任务产生代码改动时，应先审查差异，再决定保留、提交或继续迭代。

主要工作区域
| 区域                     | 用途                                                                 |
| ------------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 编程与通用               | 在面向工程任务的工作区组织方式和面向通用任务的文件夹组织方式之间切换 |
| 新任务与搜索             | 创建独立任务，或按标题、用户消息和助手回复检索历史会话               |
| 工作区或文件夹与最近任务 | 按项目组织任务，快速回到已有上下文                                   |
| 需要我                   | 集中查看待响应请求、任务结果和协作消息。                             |
| 知识库                   | 从更多 → 知识库管理需求、设计等参考资料，在任务中复用。              |
| Repo Wiki                | 从更多 → Repo Wiki 生成和查看代码仓库的项目知识。                     |
| 自动化                   | 按计划启动 Agent 工作，并集中查看执行记录                            |
| 扩展                     | 管理 Skills、Plugins 和 Connectors，扩展 Agent 能力                  |

查看活动与权益提醒
侧栏收到活动通知或权益提醒时，点击提醒查看详情，按页面说明参与活动或领取权益。 提醒是否显示取决于当前账号收到的通知。参与或领取前先检查适用条件，并按页面要求完成操作；收到提醒不会自动参加活动或领取权益。

能力地图
开始新任务：选择编程或通用模式，关联工作区或文件夹，然后直接输入任务。
自定义模型：通过 API 密钥接入受支持的第三方模型。
任务管理：排序、筛选、搜索、归档和恢复任务。
工具与操作：使用内置浏览器、代码审查与提交以及终端。
安全与授权：了解账号、凭证和访问授权的安全边界。代码扫描见代码安全专题。
环境与执行：选择执行环境，以计划或目标驱动任务。
连接其他设备：连接局域网内的 Qoder，在授权工作区中执行任务。
自动化：按计划运行重复任务并查看执行记录。
知识库：管理参考资料，并在任务中使用。
Repo Wiki：为代码仓库生成和维护项目知识。
扩展能力：通过 Skills、Plugins、Connectors、Hooks、智能体、应用快照和电脑操控扩展 Qoder。
智能体：配置本地或云端智能体，复用工作指令与资源。
个性化设置：配置模式、语音、快捷键、模型、记忆和其他应用偏好。
图片和视频生成：描述画面内容与风格，生成图片或视频并检查结果；暂不支持 BYOK。
Office 插件：通过 Excel 和 PPT 插件处理表格与演示文稿，并在桌面端检查、编辑和保存。
